Container.Name: DeckMover
Container.Overview: Warm Unraid cache with Plex Continue Watching items using direct SQLite database access. Optionally moves watched items back to the array. All settings are configured through the built-in WebUI — open it after starting the container.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the DeckMover web interface. Open this after starting the container to configure settings.

Config.Name: Array Root
Config.Description: Unraid array root. Use /mnt/user0 (not /mnt/user) to bypass the user share layer.

Config.Name: Plex Database
Config.Description: Plex appdata directory. Must contain Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server/Plug-in Support/Databases/ inside it.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent config directory. DeckMover saves settings here (deckmover.env) so they survive container updates.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Log directory. The last 12 run logs are kept as rotating files.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership. Use 99 (nobody) on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership. Use 100 (users) on Unraid.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone. Affects scheduling and log timestamps.
